items: New: sound! Every surface sounds different: clacking concrete, hollow wooden boardwalk, crunchy snow, gritty sand, clunky temple stones and rough lava rock. Rails ring, ledges scrape and logs rasp when you grind, and every world has its own sounds around you, like waves, birds, city traffic, wind and bubbling lava. Turn it off on the title screen
New: put the game on your home screen! On the iPad tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It opens full screen and works without the internet
Better: lava gaps bubble and glow, getting darker the deeper they go

New: every track has its own landmarks to spot, like a ferris wheel, lighthouse, shipwreck, blimp, helicopter, ski jump, igloo, saloon, rock arch, jungle temple, waterfall, lava fall and giant dinosaur bones
Better: water gaps have ripples instead of a flat white top

New: every track has its own weather or time of day. Ride at sunrise, sunset or at night under the stars, in rain, mist, snowstorms and sandstorms, under the northern lights, or while the volcano erupts
Fixed: trees, palms, lamps and other scenery were sunk into the ground or lying on their side. They stand up properly now
Better: fences follow the hills, the ski lift has cables and chairs, and the snowy mountains and desert mesas look like real ones
New: 10 Volcano tracks to finish the game, with lava gaps, rails over lava, lava tube loops and one last giant leap into the crater
New: 10 Jungle Ruins tracks to ride to the beat, with river gaps, log grinds, temple steps and a waterfall jump
New: 10 Desert Canyon tracks, with deep gullies to pump out of, rails across them, and your first loop-the-loops
New: 10 Snowy Mountain tracks, with crevasses, a frozen lake, down rails and giant kickers for backflips
New: 10 Downtown Rooftops tracks, with gaps between buildings, stair sets, handrails and giant billboard jumps
New: mega ramps! Drop in from way up high, jump the giant gap, then fly off the quarter pipe. You get three drops
New: 10 Beach Boardwalk tracks to ride, with water gaps, pier rails and big swells, and 3 challenges on each
New: 10 Sunny Park tracks! Each one teaches a move, and has 3 challenges. Do them to earn stars and open the next track
Better: the ollie is bigger and slower: a deep crouch, a big tail snap, then he springs up and tucks his knees
Fixed: dropping into a half pipe no longer stalls for a moment at the top, so you fly down the wall
Better: dropping into a half pipe gives you more speed, so you get air straight away
New: after an update, What's New opens by itself and shows what each update added
New: half pipes start up on the edge. Tap to drop in, and the clock starts when you do
Better: a real ollie! Snap the tail, slide your front foot up, tuck your knees and bend them to land
Fixed: the dips in Dry Gulch are smoother, so you can pump through them instead of flying into the far side
Better: ollie just before a rail and you hop right onto it
Better: the snowboard's nose and tail kick up like a real one
New: loop-the-loops in the Jungle and Volcano! Pump hard to get round
New: on a rail, swipe on the right for a Boardslide, 5-0 or Nosegrind!
New: grind rails, ledges and stair sets! Ollie onto a rail to grind it
New: watch your best tricks again in slow-mo! Tap REPLAY after a big combo
New: ride a snowboard on the snow level, with a beanie and goggles!
Fixed: the update button now makes sure you really get the new version
New: the title screen shows which version you have
New: a Trick Guide on the main menu shows every move
Fixed: the skater's legs no longer poke through the ground
New: the game tells you when there's an update, and what's in it!
New: spins! Swipe sideways along the bottom of the screen
New: tilt the iPad to do manuals on the ground and flips in the air
New: grabs! Swipe and hold on the left side of the screen
New: a half-pipe bonus level in every world
New: three lives on every track
New: six worlds to skate, from the beach to a volcano
